from enum import Enum
from django.utils.translation import gettext_lazy as _
from django.db.migrations.serializer import serializer_factory

class Status(Enum):
    GOOD = _('Good')
    BAD = _('Bad')
    def __str__(self):
        return self.name

s, imports = serializer_factory(Status.GOOD).serialize()
print("serialized:", s, "| imports:", imports)

# round-trip: the generated code must evaluate back to the same member
ns = {}
exec("import __main__; " + "res = " + s.replace("__main__.", ""), {"__main__": __import__("sys").modules["__main__"]} if False else {"__main__": __import__("sys").modules["__main__"]}, ns) if False else None
import __main__
res = eval(s, {"__main__": __import__("sys").modules["__main__"]})
print("round-trip ok:", res is Status.GOOD, repr(res))

# name lookup is translation-independent; value lookup is not
print("by name:", Status['GOOD'] is Status.GOOD)
EOF
